subject: Repository and Credential Hygiene Certification (pre-Phase-12 gate)
scope: credential/history audit, secret untracking, tracked-venv/bytecode removal, import-time network isolation, reproducibility. No strategy, trading-logic, or LIVE changes.

credential_audit.method: full-history scan: git log -p over 114 commits (excl. .venv/__pycache__/*.pyc); filename scan for *.pem/*.key/.env*/secret*/token*/credential*; private-key pattern scan; non-empty assignment scan for DELTA_API_KEY/DELTA_API_SECRET/CONTROL_API_TOKEN/REMOTE_*_TOKEN/QENGINE_CLIENT_TOKEN

real_secrets_found.where: tracked .env (5 commits: 63cd4f1, e686ccd, d5846fc, e49f61e, 2f9bf0e; unchanged value; present in HEAD until 11D)

not_real_secrets: certifi cacert.pem bundles inside tracked .venv (public CA certs)
CONTROL_API_TOKEN='...' placeholder, 'change-me-strong-secret' example scripts, 'tok'/'abc'/TOKEN test fixtures
code references to env var names (os.getenv) without values
credential_audit.remote_exposure: origin https://github.com/vishalkharade1-svg/quantengine-spring-41.git exists - pushed history may expose the .env secrets; rotation is mandatory regardless of local purge

remediation_done.isolation_mechanism: offline unit tests by default; original live/demo behavior under __main__ + QE_LIVE_SMOKE=1 opt-in

deferred_gate.item: history purge (remove .env secrets from all git history) + force-push to origin
deferred_gate.reason_deferred: origin exists: local-only rewrite gives false cleanliness; rotation must come first (purge does not neutralize already-pushed secrets); rewrite invalidates all prior evidence hashes (requires old-to-new hash remap); git filter-repo not installed
operator_steps: 1. Rotate/revoke the Delta API key + secret in the Delta dashboard (do this FIRST)
2. Confirm no live system depends on the old pair
3. Run history purge (e.g. git filter-repo --path .env --invert-paths, or equivalent) and verify with the 11D audit scans
4. Record old-to-new commit hash mapping for Phase 10/11A/11B/11C evidence commits
5. Force-push to origin and confirm GitHub secret scanning is clean
6. Never put replacement credentials in the repository (.env stays untracked)

verdict: PHASE 11D: GREEN (HYGIENE) - CLOSED with one deferred operator gate: credential rotation + history purge before LIVE readiness. Phase 12 NOT STARTED. LIVE trading remains disabled.
